summary: RETEST #2 of the typography/layout regressions. FRONTEND ONLY: Expo web at 390x844, 375x667, 320x568 and 768x1024, checked with the DOM overflow audit, per-element measurements and screenshots. PASS: (1) Onboarding slide 4. At 375 and 320 the headline, subtitle, bullet row, dots, 'Let's go' and 'Sign in' are all visible above the footer. Slides 1-3 are fine and 390 is fine. (2) Shop prices. On /shop/category/all?deals=1, /shop/category/furniture, /shop/search and the market deal carousel (390 and 320), 0 of more than 150 price texts are truncated or outside the card. 'From' sits above the price; the struck price and 'Reduced price' are on their own line. (3) Owned passport sticky bar: 46px icons with the full 'Manage' label at 320; 54px icons and the lg pill with icon at 390 and 768. (4) Unlock CTA at 320 reads 'Unlock · 1,200 MASS' plus 'You have 300 MASS'. Home tiles at 320 read 'Unlock · 1,200 MASS' in full with a 44px save circle. (5) The hero-locked-photos pill sits 14px above the FOR SALE/Premium badges at 320 and 390, no overlap. (6) Updates title fits at 320 with no emblem. Neighbours title is 26px and fits. Tab label 'Neighbours' is 55px wide in a 59px tab, no ellipsis. (7) The score grid is 2x2 and WALK/SCHOOLS/SAFETY/INFRA are all visible at 390 and 320. (8) Become-agent: my-reps-btn and see-plans-btn are full width with full labels. (9) Market location pill is icon-only at 320 and shows 'All of Nigeria' at 390; basket and saved are visible. (10) Home placeholder 'Search area, landmark' at 17px is 182px wide in 202px available at 390. promo-badge-feature 'Featured · 14d left' shows in full and its row wraps. (11) stat-unlocked = 0 and /unlocks is empty; the 'My unlocks' title fits at 320. Tablet home and passport are clean. No console errors. NEW/REMAINING: /shop/search shows a single column at 320. The unlock CTA balance line is truncated at 390. Smaller truncations are listed below. 'Chat · Free' could NOT be tested: there are no is_free_amass_sale listings, and demo has 0 unlocks.

ui_bugs.issue: Results show as ONE column of 140px cards, leaving the right half of the screen empty. RCA: search.tsx:50 sets cardW = floor((320-32-12)/2) = 138, but ShopProductCard styles.card has minWidth: 140 (ShopProductCard.tsx:183). Two cards (2x140+12 = 292) no longer fit the 288px row, so flexWrap drops each card to its own row. At 390 it is 2 columns and correct.
'You have 300 MASS · confirm before paying' is truncated to 'confirm before …' (scrollWidth > clientWidth, 234px box), so the word 'paying' is cut.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Under-priced' tag is truncated to 'Under-pric…' (12px font in a 76px box).
The 'Shared lists' and 'Local map' labels are truncated to 'Shared l…' and 'Local m…' (12px font, 58px tiles).
Cards measure 16-156 and 168-308, so the right card enters the 16px right padding by 4px (12px right margin against 16px left). Cards in the same row also differ in height (275 vs 283).

action_items: MEDIUM: fix the 1-column /shop/search grid at 320. Either lower ShopProductCard styles.card minWidth (e.g. 130), drop the minWidth when an explicit width prop is passed, or clamp cardW. Then recheck /shop/category at 320 (4px right-padding overflow).
LOW: keep 'confirm before paying' in full on the unlock-cta-btn subline at 390 (shorter copy or a narrower threshold).
LOW: stop 'Under-priced' truncating at 320 (let the AI value chip wrap, or shorten it to 'Under').
LOW: fix the Neighbours quick-tile labels at 320 (smaller font, 2 lines, or shorter labels: 'Lists' / 'Map').
LOW: onboarding slide 4 at 320: shrink the chip padding or font so 2 chips fit, or accept the scroll peek.
LOW: finish the Boosts subtitle copy ('views since boost').
Untested: 'Chat · Free' needs a non-owned unlocked or is_free_amass_sale listing. None exists for demo; the code path (tight → md, no icon) mirrors 'Manage'.
critical_code_review_comments: ShopProductCard styles.card { minWidth: 140 } conflicts with the cardW computed by callers on narrow screens (search.tsx:50). Any caller that passes a width below 140 will get wrapping or overflow.
neighbours-title at 390 (38px font, lineHeight 44): the audit sees a 4px vertical overflow (scrollHeight 48 against 44), but nothing is visibly clipped.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all 11 targeted checks pass except Chat · Free, which could not be tested; 1 MED and several LOW new findings)
